description: This file contains benchmarking code for the AgentField TypeScript SDK, measuring registration time, memory footprint, cold start, and request latency.

classes.name: BenchmarkResult
classes.description: Interface representing individual benchmark metrics with optional iterations count.

classes.name: BenchmarkSuite
classes.description: Interface representing a collection of benchmark results and system info.

classes.name: Stats
classes.description: Interface for statistical summary of benchmark data.

methods.name: calculateStats
methods.description: Calculates statistical metrics (mean, stdDev, min, max, percentiles) from an array of numbers.

methods.name: getMemoryUsageMB
methods.description: Returns current heap memory usage in megabytes.

methods.name: benchmarkRegistration
methods.description: Benchmarks handler registration time over multiple iterations.

methods.name: benchmarkMemory
methods.description: Benchmarks memory footprint after registering handlers.

methods.name: benchmarkColdStart
methods.description: Measures cold start time of the Agent.

methods.name: benchmarkRequestProcessing
methods.description: Measures request processing latency across multiple handlers.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating all benchmarks and outputting results.
